name: 3-D ESCOT
aliases: 3-D Embedded Subband Coding with Optimal Truncation
Three-Dimensional Embedded Block Coding with Optimized Truncation
definition: An algorithm for scalable wavelet video compression that uses 3-D context formation and modeling for arithmetic coding, differing from SPIHT by abandoning zerotrees.
summary: 3-D ESCOT is a volumetric wavelet entropy coding method that abandons zerotrees for 3-D context modeling and applies high-order arithmetic coding to sign and refinement bits.
